details.biography:
The Broken Anvil · Level 9 - The Veterans · Seat 1, Front line

A towering Red Waste raider turned Keeper who hits first and hits hardest. Loud, warm and blunt; treats every fight like a contest he fully intends to win. Joined the Keepers after they pulled his raiding band out of a goblin warren; he pays his debts in blood and laughter.

In a fight

Close fast and swing before enemies act (Ambush Strike), Rage on your first swing, Whirlwind the hobgoblin guards, and when the troll drops, oil it or torch it.
details.backgroundStory:
Abilities (from the printed sheet)

Rage. As part of an attack or your move, rage for up to 6 rounds, 4 times per day. While raging: +2 melee weapon damage. Ends early if a full round passes without you attacking or taking damage.

Extra Attack (7th). When you take the attack action, make one more weapon attack, with Disadvantage.

Whirlwind Attack (4th). Once per encounter, instead of your normal attacks: one attack roll against each of up to 3 opponents within 5ft whose Level is 4 or lower. You cannot have retreated before using it. Hobgoblin guards (Level 1) and captains (Level 3) qualify; the warlord (8) and troll (10) do not.

Intimidate (Strength). Uses your action. One creature of Level 9 or lower within 15ft makes a Will save (DC 17) or has Disadvantage on attack rolls for 1d4 rounds. Each creature can be targeted once per encounter.

Primeval Will (6th). Once per day, when your HP drops to 18 or less, gain 18 bonus HP (lost first, gone when combat ends). Triggers automatically if you drop to 0 or below; if that leaves you at 1+ HP you keep fighting. Cannot stop a blow that kills you outright.

Combat Sense. +2 to surprise checks. Attackers get no Advantage on you from flanking or being Unseen, and Back Attack style bonuses do not work on you.

Thick Hide. +2 AC in no armour or light armour (already in your AC).

Primeval Instincts. In light or no armour, once per round, +4 to a Strength, Dexterity or Constitution check in extreme circumstances (breaking free, holding a door, leaping a hazard). Also: hold breath twice as long, climb natural slopes and swim rivers at half speed without a check.

Kit: Ambush Strike. Advantage on your first attack roll each round against a target that has not yet acted in this combat.

Kit: Desert Born. Advantage on Survival in arid or desert terrain, and on identifying Red Waste tribal markings or customs.

Large. 10ft x 10ft space, +5ft melee reach, ignore the Heavy weapon Disadvantage. Disadvantage on Stealth and on squeezing through tight spaces.

Mountain Endurance. Once per long rest, when hit, reduce the damage by 1d12+3 (spend 1 Luck for another use). Advantage on Fortitude saves against exhaustion, forced marching and thin air.

Giant-kin strength. Advantage on Strength checks to push, drag, lift or break against a smaller creature or object.

Resistance to cold. Resistance 5 to cold damage.

Darkvision. 60ft.

Jotunas Goliath. Advantage on Jotunas terrain, tribal-custom and true-giant-lineage checks, and on Charisma checks towards Dul Khagul dwarves.

Weapon training. Two-handed axe, maul, javelin, greatclub (Barbarians already use any weapon).

Toughness (1st, General). +1 Max HP per level (+9, included), +1 Constitution (included), Advantage on Constitution checks.

Critical Strike (2nd, Martial). Your weapon attacks crit on a natural 20, or on a natural 19 that hits. A crit adds the maximum of the weapon dice.

Armour Master (6th, Martial). +1 AC while wearing armour (included).

Speed, initiative and HP. Speed: 30ft (Large: 10ft x 10ft space, 10ft melee reach) · Initiative: +1 · HP: Level 1: d12 max 12 + Con +3 = 15. Levels 2-9: 8 x (7 + 3) = 80. Toughness: +1 x 9 levels = 9. Total 104.

Armour Class on the sheet: 10 + 4 (Studded Leather +1) + 1 (Dex) + 2 (Thick Hide, light armour) + 1 (Buckler) + 1 (Armour Master) = 19

Class Abilities

1st Level

Combat Sense

  • Effect: Heightened battlefield awareness that makes the Barbarian difficult to catch off guard.
  • +2 to surprise checks against anyone attempting to surprise the Barbarian
  • Attackers gain no Advantage from flanking or from being Unseen against you
  • Back Attack and similar rear-attack bonuses (such as the Rogue's) do not work against you

Rage

  • Effect: As part of an attack or your movement, enter a rage for up to 3 + Constitution modifier rounds (minimum 3 rounds), usable 1 + Constitution modifier times per day (minimum 2/day).
  • While raging, gain a flat bonus to melee weapon damage: +2 (1st-9th level), +4 (10th-19th level), +6 (20th+).
  • Rage ends early if a full round passes without the Barbarian attacking or taking damage.
  • Stacks normally with Primeval Will and Whirlwind Attack.

Intimidate (Strength)

  • Effect: Uses your action. One creature of equal or lower Level within 15ft makes a Will save (against your Class Save DC) or has Disadvantage on attack rolls for 1d4 rounds.
  • No daily limit, but a creature can be targeted only once per encounter

Primeval Instincts

  • Effect: When not wearing medium or heavy armour and having not fled the challenge, gain +4 to any physical attribute check (Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution) in extreme circumstances once per round.
  • Hold your breath twice as long as normal
  • Survive extreme temperatures and weather 1 day longer than normal
  • Advantage on Fortitude saves made to force march
  • Find shelter, food, and water for themselves automatically in any wilderness environment (1d6+2 hours)
  • Start a fire in 1d10 minutes by natural means
  • Determine true north at will
  • Climb typical natural slopes and swim typical rivers without a check — half speed, in light armour or none
  • Cannot use the shelter, fire, navigation and climbing abilities above while wearing medium or heavy armour

Thick Hide

  • Effect: While wearing no armour or light armour, gain +2 AC (+3 from 10th level). It does not stack with other bonuses of the same kind.

4th Level

Whirlwind Attack

  • Effect: Once per encounter, replaces the normal combat action. Make one attack roll against each of up to 2 opponents within 5ft whose Level is no greater than half the Barbarian's level.
  • Can split attacks between targets freely
  • Cannot retreat before using it
  • Scales with level — see the Barbarian Progression Table

6th Level

Primeval Will

  • Effect: Once per day, when HP is reduced to twice your level or less, immediately gain bonus HP equal to twice your level.
  • The bonus HP absorb incoming damage first
  • Any remaining bonus HP are removed at combat's end
  • If reduced to 0 or negative HP before activation, it triggers automatically — if the resulting total is 1 or more HP, the Barbarian keeps fighting
  • Cannot prevent death from a blow that would kill you outright

7th Level

Extra Attack

  • Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).

10th Level

Ancestral Calling

  • Effect: Once per week, inspire nearby allies — each affected creature gains temporary HP equal to the maximum roll of one extra HD appropriate to their type (a Fighter gains +10 HP, etc.).
  • Affects creatures of Level up to twice the Barbarian's level
  • Lasts until the end of the day or completion of the current task
  • Cannot combine with another Barbarian's use of the same ability

13th Level

Iron Sinews

  • Effect: Your weapon attacks count as magic, so they can harm creatures that only magic weapons can hurt.

15th Level

  • Strength Bonus: permanent +1 Strength

16th Level

Force of Nature

  • Effect: Gain a +2 bonus to saving throws against spells and magical effects. Magic from the primeval world bends around the Barbarian's raw will.
  • Improves to +3 at 19th level
  • Improves to +4 at 22nd level

20th Level

Warlord

  • Effect: Once per month, in an area where the Barbarian's name and deeds are known, call up an army of 10–100 1st level barbarians.
  • Requires a population of 500 per 10 men needed in the area
  • Army stats: AC 13, armed with sword or axe
  • For every 20 barbarians, a 3rd level barbarian leads them
  • They fight for 30 days without pay — food and water only
  • Repeated failed campaigns reduce this ability until reputation is restored

24th Level

World Ender

  • Effect: Your mastery of combat reaches a mythic threshold — nothing within reach is safe, and nothing without magic stops you.
  • Whirlwind Attack can now target all creatures within 10ft regardless of Level; the normal Level cap is removed entirely

Kits — Arneyan Warrior Cultures

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Barbarian folder. Drag one onto your character.

Choose one Kit at character creation. Your kit defines the warrior culture that shaped you.
